scope: Every nonempty paragraph in sources 1–3; explicit recalled-question lists and identified standalone oral questions in source 4. Source 4 is the primary answer substrate, not a claim that its entire textbook has been copied into the app.
exclusions: Four bare question marks in source 1 (77, 79, 80, 81) are unrecoverable.
Chapter headings, answer subheadings and reference-book headings are not additional recalled exam questions.
Source 2 paragraphs 354 onward are supplemental practice, not proven real-exam recall.
Fixed percentages and unsafe treatment assertions are qualified or corrected; they are not silently repeated as facts.
